set.body:
Study demonstration for the engineering finish line (owner, 2026-11-16): a usable representation for film recall studies, shown on Sherlock, FilmFestival and Friends. Plan: docs/plans/2026-11-16-detail-mapping-plan.md, section "Finish line: a usable representation for film recall studies".
Acceptance: for each of the three studies, one documented command takes its timed film descriptions and recall transcripts through its input adapter and produces the common bundle; the contract's three views (recall-indexed feature table, with a recall-time matrix where the study's timing permits; recall-source correspondence table; source-indexed participant summary) are derived from the saved artifacts without a model call; an independent reader recomputes them. Formats, readers and scorer are identical across studies. Each study has an availability report: fields and views present, their coverage, and what is unavailable and why.
Material: development material only. Friends development participants through the guard; sealed test side unopened. The untouched Sherlock remainder is not read. Outputs stay in private ignored storage.
This is an engineering claim permitting experimental use. It qualifies no measure scientifically and consumes no fresh data.
Slice per study when work starts.
set.title: [detail-mapping] Study demonstration: contract views on Sherlock, FilmFestival and Friends
